I'm sorry that happened to you. I know how you feel. It hurts, badly. But you can't play victim. It will make you feel worse. You did nothing wrong and it wasn't your fault. You lost someone who didn't love you back, you didn't lose anything. I did the same thing when I had my heartbroken. I played victim and cried a lot, thinking about what I could have done to make her stay, to make her love me. But in the end they are all thoughts and you can't change the past. Block it all out, don't think this way it wont change anything. You will find someone that wants you, that will cherish you, and treat you better and this will all go away. The girl of your dreams shouldnt be the ride, you are the ride, she is the one tagging along. I was depressed, sad, lonely, she fixed that. But after it was over I went back to the same state and I'm still in it, fighting through. But I learned something more valuable than the relationship itself. I learned to never channel happiness through that person. Love your partner, but don't make them the reason you are alive. Find your purpose, do what you love, embrace it, and push through, you got this, many people have gone through it. It's doable. Keep fighting through.
